conditions: The licensee distributes a Derivative Work in Source form under section 4.
The files at issue were modified by that licensee and are included in the distributed Source.
limitations: The claim covers changed files included in the distributed Source. Object-only delivery and other modification histories are outside its scope.
Whether a particular change notice is prominent depends on its presentation and circumstances.
Other distribution conditions and existing upstream notices require separate assessment.

triggers: The ASF corrects or replaces the applicable clause, definitions, or cited edition.
The exact source representation, cited byte ranges, or scoped proposition changes.

statement: When a licensee distributes a Derivative Work in Source form under Apache License 2.0 section 4, section 4(b) requires the files it modified and includes in the distributed Source to carry prominent notices stating that the licensee changed those files.
